slides.title: Delete the two largest values. What happens to the ==median==?

slides.stem: A data set of 11 values has a median of 45. If the two largest values (both greater than 45) are removed, what is the new median?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: D — Cannot be determined
slides.body: The median of 11 values is the 6th. Most students pick A (Less than 45): assumes the 5th value is strictly below 45, but it could equal 45.

slides.title: Median After Removal Reasoning
slides.body: For removal or insertion problems, check whether the data is constrained enough to fix the new median. "Cannot be determined" is the right answer when more than one outcome is consistent with the given facts.
